notes:
REF-BM-02: No remote metadata collection is implemented.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but description and auto-collected metadata are absent.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and notes are editable, but no description field exists.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are warned about only after a second bookmark is created; duplicates do not converge to editing.
REF-BM-07: Items show title and tags, but lack description and favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with autocomplete disabled.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and notes, but no description field exists.
REF-BM-14: #tag search syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal text including quote characters, not exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Results are fixed to newest-first; no selectable sort key is implemented.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written but are rendered only as plain text, not Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive is unavailable, so reversible archive versus permanent delete is not distinguished.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: No saved bundles or reusable filter combinations exist.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings exist.
